verdict.rationale: Mistral documents regional inference as an optional service: dedicated API endpoints route model execution to infrastructure in a selected geography, currently the EU or the US. Its open-weight models can also be self-hosted anywhere, which gives full residency control, and community comments note EU companies choosing it for local or self-hosted deployment. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that data at rest (storage, logs, uploaded documents) stays in the chosen region rather than only inference execution; choices beyond EU/US; independent hands-on corroboration of the regional endpoints.
